intro: This errand directs rising Horde warriors to Thunder Bluff to consult with Orm Stonehoof, an artisan smith. Recommended by Thun'grim Firegaze, Orm possesses the specialized craft required to forge the Brutal Helm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orm Stonehoof is respected greatly for his skill. He will make for you the brutal helm.
Seek him out in Thunder Bluff, near the pool by the city's great, central totem.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, adventurer. I am Orm, and Thun'grim tells me you wish a helm made?
